title: Systems Programming Resources
body:
Search has degraded to the point where I have been using ddgr for 50% of my web searches, so I figured I'd just start keeping track of webpages I use most often here. This will naturally evolve over time. This are helpful resources for systems programming tools (mostly for C/C++) but also some general stuff.

C/C++ Development:
  • gdb debugger tutorial
  • gdb official docs
  • CMake getting started
  • CMake official docs
  • Valgrind User Manual
  • Nicely formatted C docs
  • Official cpp reference
  • Clang official docs
Rust Development:
  • The Rust Book
  • Anyhow crate docs
  • thiserror crate docs
  • Rust rand book (rand crate docs)
  • Rust by example
General Stuff:
  • Make Howto
  • Makefile tutorial
  • GNU Make official docs
  • tmux getting started
  • Helix editor official docs
  • X86 Assembly Instructions
  • Nice git reference
